rules.label: Bachelor's in Informatics / CS equivalent to the TUM B.Sc. Informatics

check.note: TUM decides whether the degree is equivalent to its B.Sc. Informatics (R01).

citations.quote: Students with a Bachelor’s degree in Informatics / Computer Science which is equivalent to the B.Sc. Informatics taught at TUM are eligible to apply.

rules.label: GRE (QR >= 164 and AW >= 4.0) or a qualifying GATE CS scorecard, for degrees from Bangladesh, China, India, Iran or Pakistan

citations.quote: Applicants with a Degree from Bangladesh, China, India, Iran or Pakistan have to submit a GRE (General) Test. We have defined required minimum scores, lower scores will not be accepted!

Alternatively, students can submit a scorecard of the Indian GATE test (Computer Science; for M.Sc. CSE the Mechanical Engineering Test will also be accepted). The minimal qualifying score of the respective year is necessary.

check.note: English proof is required, but the accepted tests and minimum scores are not in the cached TUM sources (R14 source gap).

citations.quote: Proof of your English language proficiency

rules.label: TUM aptitude assessment (points on grades and documents, possibly an interview)

check.note: TUM scores grades and documents and admits, rejects or invites to an interview; no published formula to compute.

citations.quote: Depending on the amount of points accumulated, applicants are either immediately admitted, rejected, or invited to an admissions interview.

rules.label: APS certificate, for degrees from China, India or Vietnam

citations.quote: Applicants with an undergraduate degree from China, India and Vietnam have to submit a certificate from the German Evaluation Center (APS).

rules.label: VPD from uni-assist, for a qualifying degree from outside Germany

citations.quote: Applicants who did not obtain their qualification for postgraduate studies (usually a bachelor's degree) in Germany must apply for a preliminary documentation (VPD) from uni-assist, additionally to the TUM application.
